dossier.headline: A dense Q2 FY27 reporting season ran through October
dossier.summary: The season ran from early October to early November, with the notes flagging the day's reporters each morning — from Poonawalla and Can Fin on 9 October through to a day with more than 200 companies reporting on 2 November, including ITC, Marico, NALCO, UPL, Petronet LNG and Concor. The heaviest single day the notes tracked carried 75 companies from Tata Motors to BPCL. It has not appeared since 2 November.
why_it_matters: Results days drive single-stock moves that dominate the leaders and laggards lines.
Clusters of results on one day shift the whole market's tone.
The notes use the calendar to set up what matters in each session.
watch: Bajaj Finserv, Apollo Hospitals, BSE and Hindalco, flagged as reporting after 2 November.
questions: Which sectors beat and which missed, taken across the whole season?
